outcome: Adverse pregnancy outcomes (overall, maternal, neonatal, PROMISSE APO)
cohort: Pregnant patients with systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) followed at two Japanese tertiary referral centers.
finding: Tacrolimus use during pregnancy in women with SLE and lupus nephritis did not significantly influence adverse pregnancy outcomes, blood pressure, or renal function, suggesting its suitability for lupus activity control, with an optimal trough concentration of >= 2.6 ng/ml for reduced preterm birth rate.
